tagline: The FL Evolution league newsletter · est. 2019
headline: Jbird531 Wins the Final Rematch, and the Top Three Pull Away
dek: Jbird531 is 6-0, butterygoop and triccster are 5-1, and none of the three has missed the median. Plus TuanonStan and brettmn13 swap injured running backs, a Monday night flip, and the rookies so far.
lead:
Six weeks in, the top three have separated. Jbird531 is 6-0 after beating TuanonStan 129.64 to 91.70 in the rematch of last year's final, and butterygoop and triccster are 5-1. All three have been above the league median in every week; nobody else has done it more than four times. The model gives each of them at least a 94% chance at the playoffs. The next team is at 77%.

What a start like this has meant here: all four previous 6-0 teams made the playoffs and none won the title, including Jbird531's own 6-0 team in 2024, which lost the final. butterygoop has started 5-1 three times before (2019, 2020, 2021) and won the title every time.

managers.text: 6-0 with the most points in the league (915.64) and the biggest win of the week, by 37.94. Kenneth Walker (26.9), Bhayshul Tuten (22.7) and Jordan Love (20.24) led it, with Trevor Lawrence scoring 27.34 on the bench. He has beaten Sleeper's projections by more than anyone, 91.7 points, and the model gives him a first-round bye 97% of the time. Josh Allen, Lawrence and Tuten are all on bye in week 7: three pieces to replace.
managers.next: Week 7: brettmn13, a rematch of the 2024 final. brettmn13 leads the series 7-4, but Jbird531 is an 87% favorite.

managers.text: 5-1 and second in points (904.80). Week 6 was a 28.72-point win over DMsourbeer behind Isaiah Likely (20.9) and Jonathan Taylor (20.1), with Tanner McKee, a $1 claim, starting at quarterback (12.6) and Tre Tucker scoring 24.2 on the bench. Taylor has 111.0 started points since the preseason trade that brought him over. The only loss is still the 195.40 to 152.90 game against Jbird531.
managers.next: Week 7: thecreamer, a rematch of the 2021 final. butterygoop has won three straight, leads the series 8-2 and is a 70% favorite.

managers.text: 5-1 for the first time in this league, his previous best through six weeks being 4-2 in 2021. Four straight wins, and week 6 came with a perfect lineup: he trailed Wallner 86.46 to 82.20 going into Monday night and won 114.10 to 99.86. Jayden Daniels (21.0), DeVonta Smith (17.0) and the rookie Carnell Tate (16.0) led it. He leads the Coach of the year race at 93% lineup efficiency. Still 0-7 all time against butterygoop.
managers.next: Week 7: Colt45Johnson, the game of the week. Colt leads the series 5-3 and won last year's meeting 154.88 to 94.86. triccster is at 51%.

managers.text: His best start in this league; the previous best through six weeks was 3-3 in 2022. Week 6 was 121.76 to 98.08 over thecreamer behind Malik Nabers (22.5), Matthew Golden (19.4) and George Kittle (15.4), with Germie Bernard scoring 20.2 on the bench. Only two of his six weeks have been above the median, against the second-toughest schedule anyone has faced.
managers.next: Week 7: DMsourbeer, who has won four straight and leads the series 4-1. TrifectaRich is a 59% favorite.

managers.text: Christian McCaffrey scored 26.2 on Monday night, after the game was gone, and Matthew Stafford added 16.88. Juwan Johnson started and scored 0.0. McCaffrey has 108.0 started points since the preseason trade, the most of any piece in it. He also made a deal this month for Breece Hall (see the moves). The roster carries nine quarterbacks. His two previous 4-2 starts made the playoffs, and last year's reached the final.
managers.next: Week 7: RebuildingRUs. TuanonStan leads the series 3-2 and is a 62% favorite.

managers.text: 3-3, and only one of those six weeks above the median. Week 6 was a 20.84-point loss to Colt45Johnson; Chuba Hubbard (18.6) and DK Metcalf (14.8) led the lineup and Mark Andrews scored 0.9. His one previous 3-3 start, in 2024, made the playoffs. The model has him at 42%.
managers.next: Week 7: Wallner. YoungBuck04 has won the last two and leads the series 4-3. He is a 53% favorite.

managers.text: 2-4 with the fourth-most points (723.96) and above the median in four of six weeks; the losses have come by 0.18, 13.52, 30.24 and 23.68. Tyler Shough scored 26.96 for him in week 6, the best player of the week. Kirk Cousins added 18.52. MarShawn Lloyd started and scored 1.0. The model still has him at 45%.
managers.next: Week 7: butterygoop, who leads the series 8-2. thecreamer is at 30%.

managers.text: Ended a four-game losing streak, 113.92 to 93.08 over YoungBuck04, behind D'Andre Swift (21.0), Jaxon Smith-Njigba (19.4) and Caleb Williams (16.5). Above the median four times, more than his record shows. His two previous 2-4 starts, in 2022 and 2024, missed the playoffs; the model has this one at 44%.
managers.next: Week 7: triccster, the game of the week. Colt is at 49%.

managers.text: Won 89.36 to 83.60 over brettmn13, the closest game of the week, while scoring under the week's median of 98.97. Drake Maye (23.8) and Brock Purdy (17.36, on Monday night) did it, with Michael Penix scoring 23.1 on the bench. Quarterback is the position the trade market lists as his surplus. 2-4 with an 8% playoff chance.
managers.next: Week 7: TuanonStan, who leads the series 3-2. RebuildingRUs is at 38%.

tags.t: Most points left on the bench

managers.text: 2-4 without a single week above the median. Week 6 was 81.28, the quietest score of the week, in a loss to butterygoop. James Cook (22.8) was the bright spot; Bryce Young scored 19.84 on the bench and Cam Skattebo 0.0 in the lineup. The two wins came against TuanonStan and brettmn13.
managers.next: Week 7: TrifectaRich. DMsourbeer has won four straight in the series and is at 41%.

managers.text: 1-5 after a 14.24-point loss to triccster in a game he led going into Monday night. C.J. Stroud (22.98) and Tyrone Tracy (17.5) led the lineup, Jaylin Noel scored 18.7 on the bench and Bo Nix 4.48 in it. He has faced the toughest schedule in the league. Devaughn Vele, a free-agent add, has started all six weeks for 55.4, the best pickup of the season. Eleven previous 1-5 teams and none made the playoffs; his was one of them last year.
managers.next: Week 7: YoungBuck04, who has won the last two meetings. Wallner is at 47%.

managers.text: The 2023 and 2024 champion lost 89.36 to 83.60 to RebuildingRUs and is 0-6 with the fewest points in the league, never once above the median. Case Keenum started and scored 0.0. He holds the most draft capital in the league: 7 first-round picks and 17 picks in all from 2027 to 2029. The model gives him a 65% chance at last place. His only other 0-6 start, in 2019, missed the playoffs.
managers.next: Week 7: Jbird531, whom he beat in the 2024 final. brettmn13 is at 13%.

moves.intro: One new trade, two older ones still paying out, and a cheap quarterback.

items.title: Hurt running back for hurt running back
items.text: Week 5: TuanonStan sent De'Von Achane and a 2027 third-round pick to brettmn13 for Breece Hall. Neither has played since. Achane is on injured reserve. Hall has missed three straight games with a quad injury and did not practice Wednesday.
items.verdict: A dynasty bet both ways. brettmn13 adds a pick to the biggest pile in the league.

items.title: Three firsts for Puka, three weeks in
items.text: Puka Nacua has started all three weeks since the trade for 63.4 points; DeVonta Smith has 17.0 in one start. Malachi Fields has 18.1 for brettmn13, all on the bench.
items.verdict: triccster is 3-0 since. The picks are still the other half of the grade.

items.title: McKee for a dollar
items.text: butterygoop claimed Tanner McKee for $1, the quarterback YoungBuck04 cut in week 1, and started him right away.
items.verdict: A superflex start for a dollar, with Lamar Jackson out.

items.title: The one sitting there
items.text: Jahan Dotson scored 16.2 while unrostered that week. In for Jaylen Waddle (4.4), he flips brettmn13's 5.76-point loss.
items.verdict: brettmn13's second wire flip of the season; the first was Noah Fant in week 3.

trends.title: What six weeks means here
trends.text: Ten of eleven 5-1 teams in league history made the playoffs, and six won the title. 4-2 teams made it 90% of the time, 3-3 teams 57%, 2-4 teams 10%. No 1-5 team ever has.

trends.title: The rookies
trends.text: The top rookie scorers so far: Denzel Boston (63.0) for Jbird531, Carnell Tate (52.9) for triccster and Jeremiyah Love (45.6) for TrifectaRich.

trends.title: A quiet week
trends.text: Week 6 averaged 102.2 a team, the lowest of the season. Through six weeks the league is at about 112 a team, still the best start since 2021 (120.6).

history.title: Week 6, all time
history.text: The highest week 6 score on record is Jbird531's 174.96 against brettmn13 in 2019. The biggest week 6 margin is Jbird531's 139.92 to 36.42 over TuanonStan in 2024. The closest is brettmn13 over Wallner, 99.52 to 98.92, in 2022.

ahead: Game of the week: triccster and Colt45Johnson, a 5-1 team against a 2-4 team and a coin flip. Also on the board: Jbird531 and brettmn13 in a rematch of the 2024 final, and butterygoop and thecreamer in a rematch of 2021's.

nfl.note: Headlines as ESPN reported them on the date shown. Injury and depth-chart news can change before kickoff.
nfl.intro: Injuries reach the top of the table. butterygoop's Davante Adams is out 6 to 10 weeks and his Lamar Jackson has missed two straight games. TuanonStan's Breece Hall is still out, and thecreamer has the Giants' new starting quarterback.

items.headline: McCarthy nearly rallies Giants after Winston benched; Skattebo logs no carries
items.note: thecreamer has J.J. McCarthy, who scored 16.32 on his bench in week 6, and the Giants named him their week 7 starter on Wednesday. RebuildingRUs has the benched Jameis Winston.

items.headline: Jets rookie WR Omar Cooper Jr. to return vs. Patriots; RB Hall, WR Mitchell out
items.note: YoungBuck04's Omar Cooper came back and scored 19.3 on his bench. TuanonStan's Breece Hall did not practice Wednesday and is unlikely to play this week.

items.headline: Giants release RB Najee Harris 2 days after start
items.note: triccster's Najee Harris is now an NFL free agent.

items.headline: Mayfield to practice this week but Buccaneers to prep as if Daniels will play
items.note: brettmn13's Baker Mayfield practiced in full on Wednesday, and the Bucs expect to decide on Friday. Wallner has Jalon Daniels, who has been starting in his place.

items.headline: Ravens rule out QB Lamar Jackson; Tyler Huntley to start vs. Browns
items.note: butterygoop's Lamar Jackson missed week 6 and was not at the start of Wednesday's practice. Colt45Johnson has Tyler Huntley, the fill-in.

items.headline: Rams suffer several major injuries, including to WR Adams, who's out 6-10 weeks
items.note: butterygoop's Davante Adams is on injured reserve. triccster has Puka Nacua and Kyren Williams in that offense, and TuanonStan has Matthew Stafford.

items.headline: Patriots place WR Romeo Doubs (shoulder) on IR
items.note: Wallner's Romeo Doubs is on injured reserve. RebuildingRUs has four Patriots: Drake Maye, TreVeyon Henderson, A.J. Brown and Rhamondre Stevenson.
